notablePrerequisites: You have at least one blue card in hand.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dragon's Eye Savants, adding one mana of any color.
When Dragon's Eye Savants dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Dragon's Eye Savants from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Dragon's Eye Savants's morph ability by revealing a blue card from your hand, turning it face up.
Repeat.
